name: @hr360/local-core
description: HR360 Local Encrypted Database Core, Repositories and Business Logic

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const src = 'src/database/migrations'; const dst = 'dist/database/migrations'; if (fs.existsSync(src)) { fs.mkdirSync(dst, { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync(src, dst, { recursive: true }); }"
